name: cs-customer-journey-map
description: Builds a customer journey map from real tickets, with phases, actions, thoughts and feelings, the contact points where customers get confused and write in, and rewrites of the messages that cause it. Use for "run cs-customer-journey-map", "customer journey map", "why do customers keep contacting us", "customers don't read the emails", "map where customers get confused", "rewrite our order emails", "journey map from tickets", "where do our tickets start", part of the AI for Customer Service Pack by 90n.
